adjudication.rationale: In the newly added API route `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, `appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body)` will throw on invalid input, and `JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(...))` can throw if decryption fails or the plaintext is not valid JSON. There is no try/catch or `safeParse` handling, so these cases will bubble up as unhandled exceptions and result in 500 responses. The specific claim that `symmetricDecrypt` runs with an empty `CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY` is less grounded because the handler gates on `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` (truthy only when the env var is set), but exceptions from parse/decrypt/JSON.parse are still unhandled.
